items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, affiliate, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, prohibit rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, deployment, or external permission outreach pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics but not commercial/public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, image, price, trademark, affiliate, or advertising rights; public Woot terms restrict those uses. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics is yellow, operations/security sweeps are unavailable, and Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and unattributed. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Progress: official Woot documentation, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms are attached. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, image/price/trademark terms, and affiliate or advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory.

Site-specific disposition: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Their queued readiness repairs may proceed only within the existing repository-only scopes, with no DNS, credentials, analytics, consent, tracking, affiliate destinations, deployment, or launch-state changes. For complicated.work, compliance reachability is unknown and analytics is not configured. For deadlymaracas.com, compliance reachability is unknown, analytics is not configured, and the site is a parked scaffold. Acceptance requires dated before/after artifacts, deterministic validation when available, preserved parked status, and explicit unknown audience, traffic, revenue, attribution, compliance, and health fields.

Compliance and data-quality recommendation: do not grant fleet-wide legal clearance. Technical compliance results are not certification; remediate concrete failures before exposure or monetization. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary reversible growth when existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, affiliate, and data boundaries remain unchanged. Analytics source errors must not be treated as zero. Revenue remains partial aggregate attribution, so site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and causal lift are unsupported.

Continue only the two already-queued private readiness repairs for complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com. Do not create duplicate requests or requeue work. Before closing, record ownership, exact before/after artifacts, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, and preserved parked/private status. Do not treat missing readiness, compliance, analytics, revenue, or health telemetry as zero.
